demonstrates: Credential delivery on the protected channel and redaction of a failure. The Field obtains material only on the separate channel, the credential expires mid-run, and the Field emits an actionable diagnostic whose upstream detail is redacted before it ever reaches standard output.
notes: Credential material appears exactly once in this transcript, on the credential channel, and nowhere else. It is absent from the collection request, the records, the checkpoint, the diagnostics, the cursor, and standard error. Redaction of Fieldnotes' own output is an obligation; it is never a reason to reject collected evidence.

note: The Field asks for material on the protected channel named by the grant, not on standard input or output.

The only frame in the whole protocol that carries a secret. Conformance tests use a unique canary here and assert its absence from argv, the inherited environment, standard output, standard error, logs, diagnostics, cursors, Notes, and artifacts.

body.text:
# Migration Thursday

Hi Joe,

We move the tenant on Thursday at 09:00.

Alice

detail: One mail Note installed. Its identity anchors are projected onto the A1 identity list; they relate graph entities and are never used to reconcile the Note.
Durable, so the cursor advances. The cursor value is opaque and contains no credential material; conformance tests scan committed cursors for the canary.

frame.message: The credential profile 'microsoft_work' needs interactive re-authentication.

note: Core owns refresh for this Field, and the stored refresh material is no longer usable, so no new value is issued.

frame.message: Mailbox read failed: the tenant requires interactive re-authentication. Authorization header and signed continuation URL were removed before emission. Run 'fieldnotes fields auth outlook_mail_work'.

note: The Field classified and sanitized first, replaced each removed value with the exact marker, and named what it removed so a reviewer can see that redaction happened.

detail: Core applies its own second redaction pass over every diagnostic member and over captured standard error before display or persistence, covering authorization and cookie headers, token, password, secret, code and signature fields, credentials embedded in URLs or error strings, protected-channel material, and credential-like values in pagination errors.

note: Standard error carries logs, never protocol data. Core captures it into a bounded ring buffer, redacts it, and never persists it raw.
bytes_utf8: 2026-08-22T12:20:04+02:00 WARN outlook-mail: token refresh failed for profile microsoft_work; giving up after 1 attempt

meaning: authentication or credential failure; re-authentication required

detail: Field outcome is partial and actionable. The one Note collected before the failure stays current, the committed cursor stands, and nothing was removed.
